description: Defines WebSocket protocol enums, classes for WebSocket link handling, including client and server types, with upgrade, message handling, and activity management.

classes.name: WebSocket::Protocol
classes.description: Manages WebSocket frame types, masking, encoding/decoding, and request/response key generation.

classes.name: WebSocketLinkType
classes.description: Template class managing WebSocket link state, message serialization/deserialization, upgrade handling, and activity monitoring.

classes.name: WebSocketClientType
classes.description: Template class for WebSocket client connections, handling upgrade, messaging, and link state.

classes.name: WebSocketServerType
classes.description: Template class for WebSocket server connections, handling upgrade, messaging, and link state.

methods.name: ResponseKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket response key based on a request key.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Encodes data frames for WebSocket transmission.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if the link is idle.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events for the link.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data over the WebSocket link.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the WebSocket link.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades a connection to WebSocket protocol.
